# CampusCrack

> CampusCrack is an AI-powered exam-prep platform for Nigerian university students. Students upload course materials and CampusCrack generates practice exams, AI-graded written tests, flashcards, and personalized study plans.

## About

CampusCrack was founded by Greatness Ajibola Alawode, who serves as Founder and CEO. Greatness is a Cybersecurity student at Bowen University, Iwo, Osun State, Nigeria, building CampusCrack as a solo founder.

Greatness Ajibola Alawode is the Founder and CEO of CampusCrack.
